summary: Anchored cleanup across all four bipeds. Shared timeline, six moves, independent body reviews.

bodies.label: Meshy fighter (test only)
bodies.attribution: BJJ Jiu-Jitsu Woman Girl Fighter Free by Tulio Portela, CC BY 4.0. Experimental rig/skin by C08 Motion Lab. https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bjj-jiu-jitsu-woman-girl-fighter-free-8077cada67a14af18249b6af687fcc3c

tests.title: Ukemi
tests.description: Same anchored C08 performance, synchronized across four original biped rigs. C08 is unchanged; other bodies use proportional retargeting and support-phase leg IK.
limitations: C08 is the reviewed source; other bodies are new visual-review candidates.
Target bind geometry, weights and limb lengths are preserved. Scaled travel and constant initial floor calibration; no per-frame body-floor clamp.
Support IK may reach its limb limit on different proportions; armor, floor rolls and hand/back contacts require review.
Meshy fighter is an attributed CC BY 4.0 experiment, excluded from production.
